title: Coefficient-restriction transport of normalized strict-word realizations
statement:
Fix $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R=\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/(\varpi^n)$ for $n\ge1$. All schemes and morphisms are separated of finite type over $k$. Use the operation datum [def-fix-six-functor-datum], the compactifications $c=(j,p_c)$ of [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], and $F_f^c=Rp_{c*}j_!$ with its specified integral realization [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Integral coefficients mean the completed ring sheaf $\widehat R_T=\varprojlim_n(A_n)_T$ on the small pro-etale site; $D^b_c(T,R)$ is the derived-complete category whose constructible finite reductions have cohomology in one interval independent of $n$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed]. 

For every scheme $T$ let $U_T:D(\widehat R_T)\to D(\underline R_T)$ be restriction along the constant-to-completed coefficient map [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. For either coefficient sheaf use strict reduction $\mathcal R$, total limit $\mathcal L$ and their completion unit $\eta$; a strict reduction is the derived diagram-site tensor $\Delta K\otimes^L_{\Delta B_T}((A_n)_T)_n$, where $B_T$ is that coefficient sheaf [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit]. Let $U_T^{\mathcal T}$ denote termwise restriction on the derived strict-tower categories. Use the specified reduction and limit comparisons for $U$ from [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence].

Let $W^{\widehat R}=F_m\cdots F_1$ be a finite composable word of completed-ring derived direct images and quasi-compact open extensions, applied to $K\in D^b_c(T,R)$, and assume its intermediate objects are derived complete and constructible. Let $W^R$ be the constant-coefficient word in derived direct images and completed open extensions of [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit], and let $\widetilde W^R$ be its strict word in derived termwise direct images $P_u$ and open extensions $J_j$. There is a specified natural isomorphism
$$s_{W,K}:U(W^{\widehat R}K)\xrightarrow{\sim}W^R(U K).$$
Its direct-image generator is the coefficient comparison of [lem-pur-completed-coefficient-pushforward-comparison]. Its open generator is the comparison induced by the identity of extension-presheaf summands after restriction, followed by the constant-coefficient completion unit. For concatenation its normalization is $s_{VW}=(V^R s_W)\circ s_{V,W^{\widehat R}K}$, and $s_{\varnothing}=1$.

Write $q^R_W,a^R_W$ for the constant-coefficient word comparisons of [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit]. The transported maps
$$q^U_{W,K}=q^R_{W,UK}\circ\mathcal R(s_{W,K}),\qquad a^U_{W,K}=a^R_{W,UK}\circ s_{W,K}$$
identify the reduction and realization of the completed-ring word with $\widetilde W^R\mathcal R(UK)$ and $\mathcal L(\widetilde W^R\mathcal R(UK))$, respectively. They agree, as derived strict-diagram morphisms before evaluation, with restriction of the completed-ring counit-tensor/open-tensor word comparisons. They respect all quotient transitions and augmentations, and
$$q^U_{VW}=(\widetilde V^R q^U_W)\circ q^U_{V,W^{\widehat R}K},\qquad a^U_W=\mathcal L(q^U_W)\circ\eta_{U(W^{\widehat R}K)}.$$
For the empty word $a^U$ is the completion unit. For the two-letter compactification word, $a^U$ is exactly $U(d_c)$ under restriction of its specified target limit [lem-fix-compactification-completed-realization]. Thus a whole concatenated word has the same vertex map in either parenthesization. There is no uniform Tor-bound hypothesis on the input or intermediate objects.

The coherent transport through U is an agent-stated argument, not a verbatim Stacks theorem.

proof.text: Put $B_T=\widehat R_T$ and write $\rho_M:U_T^{\mathcal T}\mathcal R^B_TM\cong\mathcal R^R_TU_TM$. The hypotheses of the constant-word theorem hold: $R$ is Noetherian, $(\varpi)$ is principal, and $A_n$ is finite and perfect, with resolution $[R\xrightarrow{\varpi^n}R]$ [lem-weil-pbc-standard-quotients-perfect]. Flatness of $B_T/R_T$, its specified finite quotients and equivalence on complete objects are [lem-weil-pbc-constant-completion-equivalence]. Use the actual strict balancing $\rho$, including its augmentation and pullback cube, from [lem-weil-pbc-strict-quotient-scalar-balancing]. Its finite components are the specified finite-reduction identifications, since on the K-flat quotient presentation both send a tensor class to itself. The canonical limit comparison $\lambda:U\mathcal L^B\cong\mathcal L^R U^{\mathcal T}$ carries completion units to completion units [lem-weil-pbc-strict-scalar-completion-unit]. Thus these choices are the comparisons specified in the statement, including the augmentations; they are not chosen lifts of finite evaluations. The canonical structural maps $u^{-1}B_V\cong B_U$ and their quotient compatibility are [lem-weil-pbc-profinite-coefficient-inverse-image].

source.place: Clause (2), reduction comparisons; Stacks 099I (algebraization.tex, lemma-restriction-derived-complete-equivalence); strict augmentation and scalar normalization of the cited nodes.

proof.text: For an open letter $j$, let $h_M:Uj_!^BM\cong J_jUM$ be the identity on extension-presheaf summands [lem-sf-cbc-slice-tensor-generator-coherence], applied degreewise. Define $s_{j,M}=\eta_{J_jUM}h_M$. The assumed completeness of the intermediate object $j_!^BM$ and the coefficient equivalence make $J_jUM$ complete, so $s_j$ is invertible. Let $r_j^B:\mathcal R^B(j_!^BM)\to J_j\mathcal R^BM$ be the strict open-tensor map of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Under $\rho$ and $h$ its restriction equals the ordinary constant open-tensor map $q_j^{\rm tens}$: both maps on each extension generator send $[x]_v\otimes a$ to $[x\otimes a|_v]_v$. The scalar-unit formula sends $[x]_v\otimes1$ to $[x\otimes1]_v$, so this also identifies the augmentation. These are equations on the strict complexes for the whole coefficient tower by the cited generator-coherence statement. Now [lem-sf-cbc-extension-zero-completion] gives $q_j^R\mathcal R^R(\eta_{J_jUM})=q_j^{\rm tens}$. Substitution yields $q_j^R\mathcal R^R(s_j)\rho_{j_!^BM}=(J_j\rho_M)U^{\mathcal T}(r_j^B)$, before evaluation.

proof.text:
For a direct-image letter $u$, choose $s_{u,M}:URu_{*,B}M\cong Ru_{*,R}UM$ to be the K-injective composition comparison [lem-pur-completed-coefficient-pushforward-comparison]. It is invertible for every $u$, with no properness assumption. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ringed-diagram-restriction] to the strict diagram sites, with constant coefficient diagram $\Delta R_T\to\Delta B_T$, using the flatness and structural identifications established in step 1. Its comparison $d$ identifies derived strict direct images under restriction and respects adjuncts. The completed reduction map is the adjunct of counit tensored with the quotient diagram, and so is $q_u^R$ on constant coordinates. The counits correspond by [lem-pur-ringed-coefficient-restriction-counit], also applied to the diagram sites. Explicitly, its equation is $U\varepsilon_B\,\tau=\varepsilon_R\,u^{-1}s_u$. Tensor it with the identity of $Q_\bullet=((A_n)_T)_n$, and insert the strict balancing/pullback cube of [lem-weil-pbc-strict-quotient-scalar-balancing]. This makes the two adjuncts equal, hence gives
$$(P_u\rho_M)d_{\mathcal R^BM}U^{\mathcal T}(r_u^B)=q_u^R\mathcal R^R(s_u)\rho_{Ru_{*,B}M}.$$
All these operations took place on the diagram sites; the equation therefore includes the quotient transitions, rather than being inferred from equalities after evaluation.

source.place: Clause (2), direct-image factor; Stacks sites-cohomology.tex 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition) and the counit-tensor construction; scalar counit equation and strict pullback cube.

proof.text:
Define $s_\varnothing=1$ and recursively $s_{FV}=F^R(s_V)\,s_{F,V^BK}$ by adjoining a letter on the left. Each generator is natural and invertible on the stated complete intermediate objects, so this gives natural isomorphisms for all words. For arbitrary concatenation $VW$, induction on the length of $V$ gives $s_{VW}=V^R(s_W)s_{V,W^BK}$: in the inductive step, for $V=FV'$, functoriality of $F^R$ gives $F^R(V'^R(s_W)\,s_{V',W^BK})=V^R(s_W)\,F^R(s_{V',W^BK})$, and $s_{F,V'^BW^BK}$ completes $s_{V,W^BK}$. This also proves independence of parentheses. Set $q_W^U=q_W^R\mathcal R^R(s_W)$. Using the constant-word normalization [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit] and naturality of $q_V^R$, expand
$$q_{VW}^U=(\widetilde Vq_W^R)q_{V,W^RUK}^R\mathcal R^R(V^Rs_W)\mathcal R^R(s_{V,W^BK})
=(\widetilde Vq_W^U)q_{V,W^BK}^U.$$
Induction starting with steps 2 and 3 identifies this entire composite with the restricted completed counit-tensor/open-tensor word composite, with the intervening $\rho$ and strict operation comparisons. Thus the equality is in the derived strict-diagram category. Invertibility follows from invertibility of $q_W^R$ and $s_W$.

source.place: Clauses (2) and (3): induction on the finite word of the constant-word normalization; assembly from the preceding generator equations.

proof.text:
Define $a_W^U=a_W^R s_W$. With $N=W^BK$ and $M=W^RUK$, the constant-word formula [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit] and naturality of the constant completion unit give
$$a_W^U=\mathcal L^R(q_W^R)\eta_Ms_W
=\mathcal L^R(q_W^R)\mathcal L^R\mathcal R^R(s_W)\eta_{UN}
=\mathcal L^R(q_W^U)\eta_{UN}.$$
The unit normalization of step 1 identifies this with restriction of the completed realization $\mathcal L^B(r_W^B)\eta_N^B$, with the canonical target limit comparison. Each strict augmentation commutes in the generator equations and in $\rho$; composing these equations retains that compatibility for the word. For the empty word $q=1$ and $s=1$, whence $a_\varnothing^U=\eta_{UK}$. Naturality of every displayed map follows from naturality of its constituents.

source.place: Clause (2), completion-unit and total-limit realization; Stacks sites-cohomology.tex 0A07 (lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim); formal assembly with the unit identity established in step 1.

proof.text: For the compactification word $W=(p_c,j)$, [lem-fix-compactification-completed-realization] specifies $d_c$ by the completion unit, the strict open-tensor comparison, and the normalized direct-image/limit comparison, with exactly the strict quotient tower defining $Rf_!^cK$. Steps 1--3 identify its unit and open comparison with the ones used in $a_W^U$. The constant-word theorem identifies its direct-image realization with the direct-image/derived-limit comparison normalized by tower projections [lem-sf-cbc-compact-support-composition-limit], and [lem-pur-completed-coefficient-pushforward-comparison] identifies that comparison under $U$, including the strict tower. Thus the same ordered composite gives $a_W^U=U(d_c)$ under the specified target limit identification. Finally the concatenation equality in step 4 and the formula in step 5 give the same $\mathcal L(q_W^U)\eta$ for either parenthesization. The hypotheses used were completeness of the stated intermediate objects and perfectness of the coefficient quotients, never finite Tor amplitude of $K$ or its intermediate objects.
